expectedBehavior: C-01 initializes exactly one independently named and coded commercial group in an existing empty group workspace.
The implementation uses a deployment-controlled platform access context and never creates an account or workspace as a C-01 side effect.
Platform-admin follows the accepted list-detail-drawer-readback interaction; operations-admin remains a separate non-business app boundary.
Gate 0 precedes all business source, and later evidence is proxy-mediated, owner-backed and cleanup-separated.

findings.title: 部署期外部前提必须以可执行且 fail-closed 的 run input 出现
findings.evidence: C-01 card §3 declares platform identity/access and existing group workspace as deployment-controlled facts; whole-scope design §1.4 and U02/U07 require a signed context plus explicit run manifest, but no implementation exists yet.
findings.risk: If a later runner silently creates a default account/workspace or accepts unverified headers, it would fabricate the approved actor precondition and invalidate C-01 business evidence.
findings.disposition: Retain as a Claude review focus and implementation acceptance criterion; do not invent credential UI, seed, root or test-only product route.

findings.title: C-01 前端来源尚未进入 Heritage registry，未来搬运前必须冻结
findings.evidence: C-01 interaction §3 marks the three workspace-management sources PENDING_HERITAGE_REGISTRATION; carry-over-first §3-4 requires registry/frozen disposition before implementation carry.
findings.risk: Copying or importing unregistered all-v2 source could hide source drift and transfer old contract/auth/scope assumptions.
findings.disposition: U05 begins with hash recheck and registry/frozen handling; until then source serves only the already accepted static visual baseline.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The plan begins with the approved system-provider task and preserves the empty-workspace and no-downstream-facts business semantics rather than treating initialization as generic CRUD.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: A C-01-only plan would leave core R3 implementation decisions to coding; copying all-v2 or adding operations login would both violate current decisions. A single C-01 plus R3-TECH chain is the smaller complete alternative.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Seven serial units keep the work bounded to one Journey and only the R3 minimum gate set; full R4 verification and all deferred business Journeys remain outside this plan.

conclusion.summary: Whole-R3 detail design is ready for independent Claude review with no M/S finding. Two N items are explicit implementation acceptance constraints, not hidden product scope.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This review approves only a proposed design packet for Claude/Dexter review. It does not authorize implementation, app/contract/database writes, runtime, seed/reset or Git.
